address: Puerto Deportivo Caleta de Vélez, Vélez-Málaga, 29751, Spain
bio: This maritime-inspired restaurant, which takes its name from the nickname given to the family that owns it, has based its success on its top-quality ingredients (the superb fish and seafood in its display cabinet are sourced directly from the fish auction) and its respect for flavour. Don’t miss the shrimp (quisquillas de arrastre), clams (coquinas), the popular “borriquete” fish, plus the divine Russian salad, which was voted the best in Spain in 2020. The terrace boasts a view of the marina....
